column1: # Where each file under lib/ultralib came from.

# commit 46d4457 "fetch correct tools when building on macOS (#100)", read from the local checkout
# ~/bk-gate/lib/ultralib (a Banjo-Kazooie fork at 0caf1df whose first parent outside the fork is 46d4457).
# No file was taken from the fork's own three commits.
# state: verbatim = byte-identical to the upstream file of the same path;
#        modified = changed here, each change inside a BUILD_VERSION conditional or noted in the file;
